operations.search: search({q,filter:{kind,family,status,evidence_class,source},match:"all"|"any",exclude,limit,offset}); quoted phrases required; max 100 hits per request; score measures retrieval relevance only
operations.get: get(id) returns full original record, supplements, typed outgoing links and canonical JSON pointer
operations.cite: cite(id) returns exact HTML line, record hash, original edition commit, source IDs and claim ceiling
operations.route: route(from,to,{maxDepth,types}) follows declared directed edges only; maximum depth 8
operations.context: context(id,{maxRecords}) packs original record and cited sources with citations; truncation explicit
operations.verify: verify() recalculates each retrieval record SHA-256; integrity supplies no independent scientific or external-origin evidence
operations.export: export() returns the complete manifest, directory and records

static_access: All records below are inert NDJSON, one complete record per line. Parse with ordinary text/HTML tools; no browser or JavaScript required. Use the directory html_line to request a finite GitHub source range. IDs also open the human dossier via #record=ID. Byte-preserved canonical JSON remains the scientific edition authority; this index is a generated mirror.
claim_limits: Undeclared evidence/status/ceiling fields remain null; consult original prose and source notes.
Graph paths represent bibliography and explicit textual references, never automatic mathematical implication.
Search relevance cannot promote evidence class, empirical acquisition, provider enforcement or Golden Egg status.
Resolve current Git/deployment identity externally; the original edition SHA labels research content, not this interface release.

intake.semantics: Preparation is read-only and PROPOSED. Source-index accession requires separately declared human review. Public merge/deployment and scientific adjudication retain their own authority. Private input cannot enter public accession output.
